description:
Mullery O’Gara are delighted to present to the market 15B St Fintans Villas. A substantial detached family home (extending to c.192 SqM including the loft conversion and c. 122 SqM excluding the loft conversion). One of a pair of similar homes, built in 2006 and discreetly set back from the road. St. Fintans Villas is ideally positioned between Monkstown, Deansgrange and Blackrock with every amenity imaginable within striking distance. 

Well-proportioned and practical accommodation briefly comprises of a wide entrance hallway with solid wood flooring. To the left of the hallway is the spacious living room with gas fire and patio door to the side of the property. Beyond the hallway is the kitchen/dining room with a range of kitchen units, peninsula island with seating, door to side and a well equipped utility room off. 

To the right of the hallway are two double bedrooms, the first is the primary suite with newly renovated walk-through wardrobe area boasting built in wardrobes and vanity area and door through to the luxurious ensuite off. Additionally at ground floor level is the family bathroom with bath, separate shower, w.c and whb. 

At first floor level are two well-appointed loft rooms and store. Loft room 1 is to the left with two velux rooflights. Loft room 2 is to the right again with 2 velux rooflights and ensuite shower room off. 

Outside to the front is parking for 2 cars and EV charging point and low maintenance gardens to the rear. 

The location is second to none, positioned between Deansgrange, Monkstown and Blackrock villages which all offer an excellent selection of shopping, cafés and restaurants. Connectivity into the city centre could not be easier with numerous bus routes linking into the city centre and further afield. There are highly regarded schools including St. Patrick's NS, Monkstown Educate Together, Newtown Park, Blackrock College, Sion Hill and Loreto Foxrock all closeby. Recreational facilities are plentiful with Newtown Park, Newtown Tennis Club, Stradbrook Rugby Club, Seapoint and Dún Laoghaire Pier are all within close proximity to Fintans Villas.
